w:r.w:t: Complete Product Specification for AI-Assisted Development

A standalone, browser-based visual workflow automation designer — similar to n8n — embedded inside the AI Social Media SaaS platform. Users can build multi-step automation workflows by dragging nodes onto a canvas, connecting them, configuring each step, and executing them. Workflows are saved locally and exportable as JSON.
Full drag-and-drop node canvas (like n8n / Zapier)
Visual edge/wire connections between node ports
Multiple named workflows in tab-based UI
JSON export and import for sharing/backup
Real AI API integration (Claude / GPT-4o) on AI nodes
Zoom, pan, minimap for large workflow navigation
Undo / Redo with full history stack
Auto-save to localStorage — never lose work
Real AI calls on AI nodes
The application is organized as follows:
├── Toolbar (actions: new, export, import, undo, redo, zoom, run)
├── StatusBar (run state, node count, autosave timestamp)
User drag → onDrop → addNode(type, position) → snapshot() → localStorage.save()
User connect → onConnect → addEdge(source, target) → snapshot() → localStorage.save()
User run → runWorkflow() → iterate nodes in topological order → update node status
AI node run → callClaudeAPI(prompt, config) → stream response → update node output
Header: icon (20x20px colored badge) + label (font-weight 500) + delete (×) button
Body: port row (input left, output right) + description text + config preview (first 2 fields)
Note area: italic note text (if note set), shown below config
Input port: left side, margin-left: -16px (overflows node left edge)
Output port: right side, margin-right: -16px (overflows node right edge)
Trigger nodes: NO input port (they are the start of a flow)
Condition node: ONE input port, TWO output ports (true / false)
Drag from sidebar → drop on canvas to add
Mousedown on node → drag to new position
Alt + drag OR middle mouse button
Drag from output port to input port
Dot grid pattern (not lines) — subtle visibility
Color: rgba(0,0,0,0.04) in light mode, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) in dark mode
Implemented via React Flow Background component (variant: dots)
Shows all nodes as colored rectangles (category color)
Viewport rectangle shows current view area
Click minimap to pan to that area
React Flow MiniMap component with custom nodeColor function
Active drag edge: dashed blue (#185FA5) animated
Condition node: true edge = green, false edge = red
Each workflow = one tab in the top toolbar
Click tab to switch active workflow
Double-click tab label to rename inline
Click × on tab to delete (confirm if has nodes)
+ button creates a new blank workflow
Save triggered on: node add, node move, node delete, edge add, edge delete, config save, note save
Storage key: wfd_v2_workflows (JSON array of all workflows)
On load: restore all workflows from localStorage
Snapshot = JSON.stringify({ nodes, edges }) of active workflow
Snapshot taken BEFORE every destructive action
Stack max depth: 50 entries (oldest dropped on overflow)
Redo stack cleared on any new action
Fit view / zoom to all nodes
When the workflow runs and encounters an AI node, it calls the Anthropic API:
system: "You are a social media AI assistant. Be concise.",
Write a {Tone} caption. Topic: {input.topic}. Max {Max Length} chars.
AI nodes show 'Test AI Call' button inside config modal
User types a test prompt in the modal input field
Clicking 'Test AI Call' calls the Anthropic API live
Response streams into a code-style output box in the modal
API key: read from env variable VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Settings modal allows user to input/update their key (stored in localStorage)
Never log or expose key in UI
If no key: AI nodes show 'API key not configured' error state
Filename sanitized (spaces → underscores, special chars stripped)
Toolbar 'Import' button opens file picker (accepts .json only)
Imported workflow added as a NEW tab (does not overwrite existing)
Validation: must have nodes[] and edges[] arrays
Node IDs and edge IDs remapped to avoid collisions
On error: toast notification with error message
After import: switch to imported workflow and fit view
Opens on double-click or right-click > Configure
Header: node icon + node type label
First field: Node Label (always present, editable)
AI nodes: additional 'Test AI Call' section
Click outside modal or Escape to cancel
System Prompt, (Test Prompt in test section)
The run engine performs a topological sort of nodes, then executes them sequentially:
Find trigger nodes (nodes with no incoming edges)
Topological sort: BFS/Kahn's algorithm to get execution order
For each node: set status = running, execute, set status = done / error
Pass output of each node as input to connected downstream nodes
On error: stop execution, mark failing node red, show error in status bar
Fixed width: 180px on desktop, collapsible on mobile
Search input at top: filters node pills by label in real-time
Nodes grouped by category with section labels
Each node pill: colored dot + label + draggable
When search active: hide empty category labels
Drag from sidebar to canvas to instantiate node at drop position
Tailwind CSS dark: variant for all colors
CSS variables used for all canvas colors (grid, edges, node backgrounds)
Manual toggle button in toolbar header
Use these prompts with Claude or GPT-4o to build this project:

"Create a Vite + React + TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, React Flow (xyflow), and Zustand. Set up the folder structure from the spec. Install dependencies: @xyflow/react, zustand, @anthropic-ai/sdk, lucide-react, tailwindcss, shadcn/ui."

"Create src/lib/nodeDefinitions.ts with the NODE_DEFS config object containing all 18 node types (schedule, webhook, manual, ai-caption, ai-image, ai-hashtags, ai-chat, ai-analyzer, post-ig, post-li, post-x, post-tiktok, approve, notify, condition, delay, loop, merge). Each entry: label, icon, color, bg, category, description, configFields array."

"Create src/store/workflowStore.ts using Zustand with persist middleware. Store: array of workflows, activeWorkflowId, undoStack, redoStack, zoom, pan, selectedNodeId, runState. Implement actions: addWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, switchWorkflow, addNode, deleteNode, addEdge, deleteEdge, snapshot, undo, redo, setZoom, selectNode, setRunState."

"Create src/components/CanvasArea.tsx using @xyflow/react. Config: zoomOnScroll, panOnDrag (alt key), minZoom 0.2, maxZoom 3, Background variant dots, MiniMap with nodeColor by category, Controls. Handle onDrop (add node from sidebar), onConnect (add edge), onNodeContextMenu (show context menu), onNodeDoubleClick (open config modal). Pass nodes/edges from Zustand store."

"Create custom React Flow node components for each category in src/components/nodes/. Each node shows: colored icon badge, label, description, input port (NodeHandle type source, position left) except triggers, output port (NodeHandle type target, position right). Apply color system from nodeDefinitions. Show first 2 config values as key:value pairs in node body. Show note in italic if set."

"Create src/components/modals/ConfigModal.tsx. Opens when selectedNodeId is set. Shows: node icon, type label, Node Label text input, then all configFields as text inputs. For AI nodes, add Test AI Call button that calls callClaudeAPI(prompt) and streams the response into a <pre> box. Save button updates node config in Zustand store and calls snapshot()."

"Create src/lib/executionEngine.ts. Function runWorkflow(workflow: Workflow): topological sort of nodes using Kahn's algorithm, then execute each node. For AI nodes: call Anthropic API with buildPrompt(node, inputData). For logic nodes: evaluate condition/delay/loop in browser. Update node status (running/done/error) via Zustand setNodeStatus action. Return execution log array."

"Create src/lib/exportImport.ts. exportWorkflow(wf): JSON.stringify with version 2.0 + exportedAt timestamp, trigger browser file download. importWorkflow(jsonString): parse, validate nodes+edges exist, remap all IDs to avoid collision with existing workflows, add to store as new workflow, switch to it, call fitView()."
